Table "account" {
  "account_id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "district_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "frequency" TEXT [not null]
  "date" DATE [not null]
}

Table "card" {
  "card_id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "disp_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "type" TEXT [not null]
  "issued" DATE [not null]
}

Table "client" {
  "client_id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "gender" TEXT [not null]
  "birth_date" DATE [not null]
  "district_id" INTEGER [not null]
}

Table "disp" {
  "disp_id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "client_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "account_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "type" TEXT [not null]
}

Table "district" {
  "district_id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "A2" TEXT [not null]
  "A3" TEXT [not null]
  "A4" TEXT [not null]
  "A5" TEXT [not null]
  "A6" TEXT [not null]
  "A7" TEXT [not null]
  "A8" INTEGER [not null]
  "A9" INTEGER [not null]
  "A10" REAL [not null]
  "A11" INTEGER [not null]
  "A12" REAL
  "A13" REAL [not null]
  "A14" INTEGER [not null]
  "A15" INTEGER
  "A16" INTEGER [not null]
}

Table "loan" {
  "loan_id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "account_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "date" DATE [not null]
  "amount" INTEGER [not null]
  "duration" INTEGER [not null]
  "payments" REAL [not null]
  "status" TEXT [not null]
}

Table "order" {
  "order_id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "account_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "bank_to" TEXT [not null]
  "account_to" INTEGER [not null]
  "amount" REAL [not null]
  "k_symbol" TEXT [not null]
}

Table "trans" {
  "trans_id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "account_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "date" DATE [not null]
  "type" TEXT [not null]
  "operation" TEXT
  "amount" INTEGER [not null]
  "balance" INTEGER [not null]
  "k_symbol" TEXT
  "bank" TEXT
  "account" INTEGER
}
